pages.text: Spread out and wide, Cody the continent stretches farther than the eye can see.
Cody is not a single place. Many lands join together to make one huge area.
Earth has seven continents. Each one is big and different from the others.
On continents, mountains rise, rivers flow, forests grow, and deserts spread.
Countries fit inside continents. Each country has its own people, homes, and stories.
People live all over Cody. So do animals, from tiny insects to huge mammals.
Wide oceans sit between continents. Water helps keep the big lands apart.
Travel across continents takes time. Planes and ships help connect the big lands.
Every continent feels special. Weather, plants, and animals can be very different.
At bedtime, we remember: continents are giant lands holding many places and people.
